title: A Ember for the Oath Revisited
author: Rosalind Almeida
blurb: Silas Fairweather, an exiled storm-caller, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
